mapper.select: SELECT SAL.BUSINESS_ID, SAL.APPROVE_NAME, SAL.APPROVE_TYPE, SAL.APPROVE_STATE, SAL.CREATE_TIME, SAL.APPROVE_BADGE FROM SMT_APPROVE_LIST SAL WHERE SAL.APPROVE_STATE = #{query.approveState} AND SAL.APPROVE_BADGE = #{query.approveBadge}

SELECT SMT_APPROVE_LIST. ID, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.BUSINESS_ID, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_NAME, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_TYPE, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_STATE, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.CREATE_TIME, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_BADGE, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.SORT FROM SMT_APPROVE_LIST WHERE SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_BADGE = #{query.approveBadge} AND SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_TYPE = #{query.approveType} AND ( SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_STATE = 1 OR SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_STATE = 2 OR SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_STATE = 3 ) ORDER BY SMT_APPROVE_LIST.CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT SMT_APPROVE_LIST. ID, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.BUSINESS_ID, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_NAME, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_TYPE, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_STATE, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.CREATE_TIME, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_BADGE, SMT_APPROVE_LIST.SORT FROM SMT_APPROVE_LIST WHERE SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_BADGE = #{query.approveBadge} AND SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_TYPE = #{query.approveType} AND SMT_APPROVE_LIST.APPROVE_STATE = 0 ORDER BY SMT_APPROVE_LIST.CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT SAL.ID, SAL.BUSINESS_ID, SAL.APPROVE_NAME, SAL.APPROVE_TYPE, SAL.APPROVE_STATE, SAL.APPROVE_BADGE, SAL.SORT, SAL.NODE_ID, SAR.RANGE_TYPE, SAR.REPAIR_TYPE, SAR.DORMITORY_NAME, SAR.FAULT_DESC, SAR.CREATE_TIME, SAR.STATUS FROM SMT_APPROVE_LIST SAL LEFT JOIN SMT_DORMITORY_REPAIRS SAR ON SAL.BUSINESS_ID = SAR.ID WHERE SAL.APPROVE_BADGE = #{query.approveBadge} AND SAL.APPROVE_TYPE = #{query.approveType} AND ( SAL.APPROVE_STATE = 1 OR SAL.APPROVE_STATE = 2 OR SAL.APPROVE_STATE = 3 ) AND SAR.STATUS != 1 ORDER BY SAL.CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT SAL. ID, SAL.BUSINESS_ID, SAL.APPROVE_NAME, SAL.APPROVE_TYPE, SAL.APPROVE_STATE, SAL.APPROVE_BADGE, SAL.SORT, SAL.NODE_ID, SAR.RANGE_TYPE, SAR.REPAIR_TYPE, SAR.DORMITORY_NAME, SAR.FAULT_DESC, SAR.CREATE_TIME, SAR.STATUS FROM SMT_APPROVE_LIST SAL LEFT JOIN SMT_DORMITORY_REPAIRS SAR ON SAL.BUSINESS_ID = SAR.ID WHERE SAL.APPROVE_BADGE = #{query.approveBadge} AND SAL.APPROVE_TYPE = #{query.approveType} AND (SAL.APPROVE_STATE = 0 OR SAR.STATUS = 1) ORDER BY SAL.CREATE_TIME DESC
